factcheck.claim: aespa released WDA (Whole Different Animal) on May 11, 2026 at 6 p.m. KST as a pre-release for LEMONADE.
LEMONADE is aespa's second full-length album, scheduled for May 29, 2026 at 1 p.m. KST, with 10 tracks.
LEMONADE follows aespa's 2024 full-length album Armageddon.
G-Dragon featured on WDA and participated in rap-making for his verse.
WDA reached top 10 on iTunes Top Songs charts in 17 regions and received QQ Music Gold Album certification for sales exceeding 250,000 yuan.
WDA topped Tencent Music's integrated K-pop chart and other China-linked digital/video charts.
Public Reddit discussion showed mixed fan reactions, including praise for the concept and criticism of structure or G-Dragon's part length.
